svg.text: Fitting the servo horn so the door shuts in the right place
Looking at the servo side of the holder. Red dot: hinge. Blue dot: link pivot on the lever. Green dot: link-to-horn screw.
Power on, tap Open the back gate once, let it finish.
The shaft now rests at the shut angle: don't turn it.
2 Hold the door shut, push the horn on
Horn points straight away from the blue pivot,
its arm touching the bump under the link.
The horn swings round and the door folds down,
then comes back to the pose in panel 2.
